identity.class_source: accepted cover class/member plus Form 4 transaction title

identity.version_semantics: only states whose H06_TIMING_V2 availability is at or before decision time

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false; omit integrity.manifest_sha256

price_basis.ratio_semantics: internally consistent with new_rate/old_rate, not source-schema pinned

remaining_blockers: new bounded SEC filing bodies could not be persisted and SHA-bound because direct SEC HTTP returned 403

split ratio provider-schema semantics and V5 normalization horizon are not frozen

shares.acceptance_policy: accepted and H06_TIMING_V2-available by decision; fact instant not after decision
shares.authority: filing-specific Inline XBRL context and dimensions
